interpretation: Post-replication Pro diagnostic only. Not a preregistered gate; forbidden for tuning, rescue, or redefinition of the frozen candidate.
numerical_note: Independent recomputation of full AUC differs from the canonical report by less than 5e-7 because the artifact labels are parsed from serialized floats; the canonical full AUC remains authoritative.
scientific_caveat: The frozen full score is almost perfectly correlated with its zone-width component, and its AUC is only marginally above the deterministic width-only AUC. This does not invalidate the frozen reaction-rank result, but it blocks any claim that persistence and family add material validated information or that the rank measures universal zone strength.
